analysis: Start-proximal RBP identity conditional on host and local RBP richness
status: Post hoc exploratory analysis motivated by Xiao et al. 2026; not preregistered or independent confirmation.
candidate_selection: Four non-exhaustive literature-motivated examples with primary experimental evidence for cellular RNA translation initiation/IRES involvement and eCLIP assayed in BOTH study cell lines. Chosen from literature and assay inventory, not ranked by existing project coefficients or p values. This is not a systematic survey of all translation factors.
not_substitutes: HNRNPA2B1 and RACK1 from the mouse Malat1 study are absent from the current assay manifest. HNRNPA1 is not a surrogate for HNRNPA2B1. This analysis does not replicate the Malat1 mechanism or identify an IRES.
population: Per-cell complete_window_eligible cohort, with no additional outcome threshold. Main S2 <=100aa, TPM>=1, valid mature transcript geometry, full U and D windows. Genuine zero RPF counts retained.
geometry: Mature RNA 0-based half-open U=[start-100,start), D=[start,start+100). D starts at ORF start, not ORF end. Same-strand >=1nt overlap with exon blocks. Whole host means all mature-transcript exons. Union labels across each RBP's original peak files, no additional peak filter. PAR_Y-preserving stable IDs; ambiguous keys fail.
identity_indicators: B=any candidate binding on host exons. A_U/A_D=any candidate binding in U/D. Enforce A_U<=B, A_D<=B. H/U/D richness includes the candidate. Five disjoint categories: B=0, B=1 U=D=0, U-only, D-only, both. Host can contribute multiple ORFs and categories; category cluster counts need not sum.
predictor_only_phase: Read only explicitly named predictor/eligibility columns, never RPF columns. Reconstruct whole-host identities from original GTF and peaks, verify all H counts, candidate U/D against frozen local labels, and compare whole-host edge cache only as an independent cross-check. Record source hashes, candidate counts and designs before outcome access.

design_guards.B0_rule: If B is variable, require >=20 unique transcripts and genes in B=0 as well. If B=1 throughout, omit only the constant B column and log that this is a host-bound population; never omit a local indicator.
design_guards.information_definition: Residualize A_U/A_D on M0. Let Q be the two orthonormal left singular vectors. For each direction and transcript/gene grouping, w_g=sum Q_ig^2; effective=1/sum w_g^2. Also require max eigenvalue(Q_g'Q_g)<=0.20 for every cluster, a basis-invariant bound for any direction. Require full design rank and rank increment2 with tolerance on original feature scale. Record normalized condition number, no outcome-based exclusion.
design_guards.interpretation: Pragmatic sparse-support and information-concentration guards, not a power calculation, equivalence boundary, or guarantee of reliable finite-sample inference. Failed tests remain in the report; no relaxing thresholds, candidate replacement, window search, or 1df rescue. Same guards apply to sensitivity designs.

M1: M0 + A_U + A_D, exactly same rows. Each candidate fitted separately; not jointly adjusting all four candidate identities.
primary_test: Per candidate-cell, nondirectional joint H0 A_U=A_D=0, OLS CR1 transcript-cluster covariance factor G/(G-1)*(N-1)/(N-K), WaldF2,G-1 approximation. 95% individual coefficient CIs use t(G-1) and are nominal. Cluster count is not replicate count.
multiplicity: One fixed family of eight planned candidate-by-cell primary joint tests. Untestable slots count conservatively as1 ONLY for Holm bookkeeping; never report that as an observed p value. Retain all eight statuses. Sensitivity families use their own labelled eight-slot corrections and are not independent confirmations. Do not compare significance across cells as a cell interaction test.
effect_sizes: Same-row delta_R2=(SSE0-SSE1)/SST; partial_R2=(SSE0-SSE1)/SSE0 reported separately. No prediction/generalization claim, no cross-population R2 comparison.
sensitivities: Same full cohort and M0/M1 plus categorical ORF biotype and linear relative_start=t_start/tx_length in both models
Restrict to B=1 hosts, drop constant B, same remaining M0/M1
Stable ENSG gene-cluster inference on each valid design
sensitivity_rule: Only base-eligible candidate-cell pairs considered; sensitivity must independently pass predeclared support/rank/concentration guards. If not, report not estimable. Baseline collinear categorical dummies may be deterministically omitted with explicit names; never omit A_U/A_D or nonconstant B.
limitations: Composition-conditional observational association, not pure local action. H and local richness include each candidate. eCLIP may reflect nuclear processing; shared exons do not prove isoform-specific binding. Outcome is ribosome occupancy, not protein yield. Unmeasured sequence/local composition, co-binding, assay sensitivity, and reverse causation remain. Nonsignificance does not establish absence or equivalence. Scope limited to four literature-selected RBPs and full100nt windows.
